LanguageData.LP_AA_ArcaneLore.label: arcane archery
LanguageData.LP_AA_ArcaneLore.description: Passive: damage +1.5% × fighter level when shooting with a ranged weapon (including arcane shots) (+30% at level 20). Arcane Archer, fighter level 3.
LanguageData.LP_AA_GraspingArrow.label: arcane shot: grasping arrow
LanguageData.LP_AA_GraspingArrow.description: Fire a guaranteed-hit shot at an enemy with your current weapon that sprouts arcane thorns on impact: an extra 8 × marksman power cut damage and move speed ×0.5 for 10 seconds. Range = current weapon range, requires a ranged weapon. Grit 1, cooldown 10 seconds. Arcane Archer, fighter level 3.
LanguageData.LP_AA_BurstingArrow.label: arcane shot: bursting arrow
LanguageData.LP_AA_BurstingArrow.description: Fire a guaranteed-hit shot at an enemy with your current weapon that bursts with arcane energy on impact: enemies within radius 2 of the impact point (including the target, excluding downed ones) each take 10 × marksman power force damage, sparing allies. Range = current weapon range, requires a ranged weapon. Grit 2, cooldown 15 seconds. Arcane Archer, fighter level 3.
LanguageData.LP_AA_KeenEye.label: eyes of the eagle
LanguageData.LP_AA_KeenEye.description: Passive: ×1.15 damage when shooting enemies 12 or more cells away (multiplies with arcane archery). Arcane Archer, fighter level 7.
LanguageData.LP_AA_ShadowArrow.label: arcane shot: shadow arrow
LanguageData.LP_AA_ShadowArrow.description: Fire a guaranteed-hit shot at an enemy with your current weapon, the arrow wrapped in shadow: an extra 12 × marksman power psychic damage and sight -60% for 15 seconds. Range = current weapon range, requires a ranged weapon. Grit 2, cooldown 20 seconds. Arcane Archer, fighter level 11.
LanguageData.LP_AA_ArrowStorm.label: arrow storm
LanguageData.LP_AA_ArrowStorm.description: Fire a sky-filling volley of arcane arrows at a point: the 10 enemies (excluding downed ones) closest to the center within radius 4 of the target point each take one guaranteed-hit bullet from your current weapon. Range = current weapon range, requires a ranged weapon. Grit 3, cooldown 60 seconds. Arcane Archer, fighter level 15.
